description:
Want to know more about the history of the City? Hop aboard our walking tour bus for fun facts and sensational stories as we wind through the City.

The tour can be taken as a whole, or you can use the bus timetable below to make your way between specific venues.

factsheet.heading: Family Day in the City - Hop on, hop off Walking Bus
paragraphs: We want Open House to be easy for everyone to enjoy, young and old.

Head to Guildhall Art Gallery and London’s Roman Amphitheatre, St Paul's Catedral, London Mithraeum Bloomberg SPACE and Dr Johnson's House on 12 September for an Open House experience made just for families.

Hop aboard our walking tour bus for fun facts and sensational stories as we wonderfully wind through the City of London to bring you to the next venue. Stay on for the whole tour, or hop off at the next venue.
